  install (default)            Copy build artifacts to prefix path
  uninstall                    Remove build artifacts from prefix path
  setup-exe                    Build the Windows installer around -Dsetup-payload into zig-out/setup/
  run                          Run the zigguro app
  run-zg                       Run the zg headless CLI
  test                         Run the tests of every package and tool
  test-setup                   Run the tests of apps/zigguro-setup
  test-apps                    Run the tests of apps/zigguro
  test-startup-allowlist       Check the app's critical startup services against packages/perf/startup_allowlist.zon
  fuzz                         Run every test (use with --fuzz to fuzz `fuzz:` tests)
  test-core                    Run the zg_core tests
  test-jsonrpc                 Run the zg_jsonrpc tests
  test-net                     Run the zg_net tests
  test-terminal                Run the zg_terminal tests
  test-mcp                     Run the zg_mcp tests
  test-lsp                     Run the zg_lsp tests
  test-dap                     Run the zg_dap tests
  test-text                    Run the zg_text tests
  test-git                     Run the zg_git tests
  test-scm                     Run the zg_scm tests
  test-platform                Run the zg_platform tests
  fuzz-wl                      Run the Wayland decoder fuzz test (use with --fuzz)
  test-security                Run the zg_security tests
  test-ai                      Run the zg_ai tests
  test-release                 Run the zg_release tests
  test-update                  Run the zg_update tests
  test-crash                   Run the zg_crash tests
  test-config                  Run the zg_config tests
  test-workspace               Run the zg_workspace tests
  test-notes                   Run the zg_notes tests
  test-regex                   Run the zg_regex tests
  test-editor                  Run the zg_editor tests
  test-vulkan                  Run the zg_vulkan tests
  test-golden                  Render the zg_vulkan scene corpus against its golden images
  test-vulkan-gpu              Run the zg_vulkan tests that need a Vulkan loader (skipped without one)
  check-vk-gen                 Compile all of the generated vk.zig for x86_64-windows, x86_64-linux-gnu and aarch64-linux-gnu
  test-syntax                  Run the zg_syntax tests
  test-gui                     Run the zg_gui tests
  test-review                  Run the zg_review tests
  test-install                 Run the zg_install tests
  test-codeintel               Run the zg_codeintel tests
  test-agents                  Run the zg_agents tests
  test-diagram                 Run the zg_diagram tests
  test-perf                    Run the zg_perf tests
  test-perf_ui                 Run the zg_perf_ui tests
  test-zg                      Run the zg CLI tests (unit and end to end)
  test-enforcement             Prove every consumer denies under a deny-all engine (INV-01)
  test-tools                   Run the tests of tools/*
  check-frame-pointers         Check that the zigguro executable keeps frame pointers
  corpus                       Generate a benchmark corpus: zig build corpus -- <profile> [--paths-only|--sparse] [--seed N]
  test-wake-sites              Fail if a new blocking wait under packages/ lacks zg_perf.idle.noteWake
  wake-sites-baseline          Rewrite tools/wake-sites/baseline.txt from the current tree
  release-tool                 Run tools/release (zg-release <command> ...; args after --)
  notices-check                Fail if a third-party data file has no packaging/notices entry
  test-build-resources         Check the manifest, VERSIONINFO and icon of Windows executables
  icons                        Regenerate packaging/icons/out from packaging/icons/logo.zig
  icons-check                  Fail if packaging/icons/out is stale
  package                      Build zig-out/dist/<t> and package it into zig-out/release (E17)
  dist                         Install stripped binaries into zig-out/dist/<t> and symbols into zig-out/symbols/<t>
  test-build-symbols           Check that release binaries split into a stripped binary and a matching .debug file
  zg-transcript                Run zg-transcript (pass arguments after --)
  check-gen                    Fail if a generated protocol file is out of date
  lspgen                       Regenerate packages/lsp/src/gen/protocol.zig
  dapgen                       Regenerate packages/dap/src/gen/protocol.zig
  vkgen                        Regenerate packages/vulkan/src/vk/vk.zig
  spirvgen                     Regenerate tools/spirv/spec.zig from the SPIR-V grammar
  shaderc                      Regenerate the SPIR-V shaders in packages/vulkan/src/shaders/gen
  spirv-dis                    Disassemble generated shaders (zig build spirv-dis -- prim_frag)
  vkgen-mini                   Regenerate tools/vkgen/testdata/golden/mini_vk.zig
  zig-pin                      Download, verify and pin the Zig toolchain (-Dzig-version=0.16.0)
  test-ci-scripts              Run setup-zig.sh against a fixture mirror (Linux)
  check-layers                 Check the package graph against tools/pkgtool/layers.zon
  check-supply-chain           Fail on any third-party code: URL deps, @cImport, libc, C sources (E16.F01.S02.T01)
  new-package                  Scaffold a package: -Dname=zg_demo -Ddir=demo -Dlayer=4
  prlint                       Lint branch, PR title, commits and docs (args after --)
  fuzz-list                    Print every `fuzz:` test target as JSON
  keysym-gen                   Regenerate the XKB keysym tables (-- --check to verify)
  tzdata-gen                   Regenerate zg_agents' embedded time zones (-- --zoneinfo <dir>, --check)
  test-build                   Self-test the build graph (spawns zig build)
  bench                        Run every package benchmark (-Dbench-quick, -Dbench-filter, -Dbench-repeats)
  bench-build                  Compile the bench binaries, perfgate, the app and the startup harness without running them
  bench-latency                Type into a 100k-line file in the app and write zig-out/bench-results/latency.json
  test-bench-scenarios         Run every app scenario once in quick mode, headless
  bench-startup                Launch the app repeatedly and write zig-out/bench-results/startup.json
  test-bench-startup           Run bench-startup with 2 headless launches
  eval                         Run the agent evaluation suite (-Deval-filter, -Deval-update-baseline, -Deval-live -Deval-model)
  docs-terminal-modes          Regenerate packages/terminal/docs/{modes,xtgettcap}.md
  test-terminal-conformance    Run the terminal .vtt conformance corpus
  budgets-doc                  Regenerate docs/perf/budgets.md from packages/perf/budgets.zon
  budgets-doc-check            Fail if docs/perf/budgets.md is stale
  perfgate                     Run perfgate: zig build perfgate -- merge|compare|baseline|list-gated ...
  bench-scenarios              Run every app scenario headless into zig-out/bench-results/scenarios.json (-Dbench-repeats)
  perf-calibrate               Measure this machine against the reference laptop: zig-out/bench-results/calibration.json
  perf-baseline                Write perf/baselines/<machine>/ from a merged bench set: zig build perf-baseline -Dmachine=M -- --from FILE
  perf-docs-check              Fail if a tools/perf/sql recipe is missing from docs/perf/profiling.md
  test-perf-compile-errors     Check that an invalid budget registry fails to compile
  fmt-check                    Fail if any file is not zig fmt clean
  cross                        Build both apps for every tier-1 target into zig-out/cross/<triple>/
  docs                         Emit autodocs into zig-out/docs/<package>
